journey.name: M5 offline like and comment are queued, then delivered
journey.description: Continues from m5-engagement. Before step 1 the backend is stopped (docker compose stop server); it is started again right after step 6 (docker compose start server).

actions.action: Tap the "Back" button to return to the feed
Tap the "Unlike" button on the post "Hello from a friend"
Verify that the post shows "0 likes" and a "Like" button
Enter "Offline hello" in the "Add a comment…" field and tap the "Post comment" button
Verify that "Offline hello" is shown with "Sending…"
Wait up to 90 seconds, then verify that "Offline hello" is shown without "Sending…"
